name: Discarded Knife
summary: The Discarded Knife is a well-kept blade found beneath the water near a missing boat in Feralas. Ginro Hearthkindle hopes it may offer a clue to Raschal’s fate.

sections.title: Beneath the Water
sections.body: At the bottom of the water in Feralas, the Discarded Knife lies near a large piece of a missing boat. Its handle is easy to find in the mud, and the blade appears well cared for. You bring it to Ginro Hearthkindle at Feathermoon Stronghold, who is searching for clues to Raschal’s fate.

sections.title: A Clue in Hand
sections.body: Ginro believes the knife may have belonged to Raschal, though finding it near the boat is not enough to settle the matter. He sends you to Quintis Jonespyre, the Stronghold’s resident druid, for a reading by touch. Quintis calls this art psychometry and hopes it will offer a glimpse of what happened.

faq.q: Where did the knife come from?
faq.answer: The Discarded Knife was found in the mud beneath the water in Feralas, near a large piece of a missing boat.

faq.q: Who might the knife belong to?
faq.answer: Ginro Hearthkindle believes the Discarded Knife may have belonged to Raschal, whose fate remains uncertain.

faq.q: Why does Ginro want the knife?
faq.answer: Ginro is searching for clues to Raschal’s fate, and hopes the knife may help reveal what happened.

faq.q: Who can read the knife’s history?
faq.answer: Quintis Jonespyre, Feathermoon Stronghold’s resident druid, uses psychometry to seek an item’s history by touching it.
Psychometry is Quintis Jonespyre’s art of seeking insight into an item’s history through touch.

angles.text: As a druid, you may recognize Quintis Jonespyre’s psychometry as an unusual art that draws on nature’s secrets.
